title: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Flows
description: Inflows, outflows, and net flows of foreign direct investment (FDI) into Malaysia.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The earliest date in the quarter is chosen, e.g. YYYY-01-01 for the 1st quarter and YYYY-04-01 for the 2nd quarter.

fields.name: inflow
fields.title: FDI Inflows
fields.description: [Float, RM bil] Inflows of FDI during the period

fields.name: outflow
fields.title: FDI Outflows
fields.description: [Float, RM bil] Outflows of FDI during the period

fields.name: net
fields.title: Net FDI Flows
fields.description: [Float, RM bil] Net flows of FDI, calculated as inflows minus outflows

methodology: FDI into Malaysia is a category of investment by non-residents that reflects the objective of obtaining a lasting interest in Malaysia. Financial instruments covered under direct investment include equity, reinvestment of earnings and debt instruments (such as inter-company loans and advances, trade credits). FDI statistics for Malaysia are compiled as part of the balance of payments, which is compiled based on the IMF's BPM6 guidelines. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/bop-technotes), particularly the definitions relating to FDI.
caveat: Values for the most recent 8 quarters may be revised in future releases.
publication: [Balance of Payments, 3Q 2025](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/bop_2025-q3), the latest edition of the quarterly BOP statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on BOP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/balance-of-payments) which enables you to explore Malaysia's BOP data interactively.
